Let
\[
p(x)=\frac13x^3-\frac12x^2+3x-\frac{5}{12}.
\]
Then
\[
g(x)=p(x)+\frac1{x-\frac12}.
\]
Pair \(x\) with \(1-x\). For the rational term,
\[
\frac1{x-\frac12}+\frac1{1-x-\frac12}=0.
\]
For the polynomial part,
\[
p(x)+p(1-x)=2.
\]
Thus
\[
g(x)+g(1-x)=2.
\]
The terms pair as
\[
g\left(\frac{k}{2017}\right)+g\left(\frac{2017-k}{2017}\right)=2,
\]
for \(k=1,\dots,1008\). There are \(1008\) pairs, so the sum is
\[
1008\cdot 2=2016.
\]

\[
\boxed{2016}
\]
